Sanford Bicycle Club Monday Ride

Sanford, FL · Historic Downtown · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Sanford Bicycle Club Monday Ride is a social group ride in Sanford, FL. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Deviant Wolfe / Dees Brothers Brewery area, downtown Sanford. Pace: casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sanford Bicycle Club Monday Ride group ride

Relaxed hour-long loop from a downtown Sanford brewery. No-drop, any bike. Listed by the local shop as the town's easy Monday ride.
